prompt: How many years after the founding of the 50th most populous US city, based on 2023 estimate population data, did Frank Fox receive UK Patent (1344259)?
answer:
The 50th-most populous U.S. city in 2023 was **New Orleans, Louisiana**, founded in **1718**.

Frank Fox received UK Patent 1,344,259 on **January 16, 1974**. Therefore:

**1974 − 1718 = 256 years**

So, he received the patent **256 years after New Orleans was founded**.
